depicted_variant: Kuda bersayap di sisi tubuh bersisik naga, berjalan di permukaan sungai tanpa tenggelam.

visual_requirements.description: Tubuh dan kepala kuda, sisik naga, dua sayap di sisi, empat kaki kuda; satu kepala dan dua mata.
Berjalan di air tanpa tenggelam; kuku menyentuh permukaan dengan percikan nyata.
Permukaan air sebagai latar tindakan berjalan di air.

aura: Sayap/sisik dan langkah di atas air c07 memberi keagungan sebagai pertanda baik c02 (klaim: longma-c07).
artistic_choices: Dipilih varian komentar umum c07; tanpa mencampur warna biru/merah varian741 c10 atau peta c08.
Sayap berbulu dan warna tembaga-sisik emas merupakan detail editorial karena bahan/warna sayap tak ditentukan.
Ukuran kuda besar biasa sekitar8chi5cun dari c07, framing rapat tanpa skala raksasa.
Cahaya matahari akhir dan percikan dari kuku editorial; tidak memakai aura kuasa.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of LONGMA, the winged dragon-scaled horse that walks on water without sinking.
ANATOMY: ONE unmistakable HORSE head with TWO eyes and TWO ears, horse neck and muscular HORSE body covered in clearly visible overlapping DRAGON SCALES; exactly FOUR equine legs with hooves, ONE horse tail; exactly TWO large feathered wings attached at its SIDES. No dragon head, no horns. [longma-c01, longma-c07]
MOMENT: advancing forcefully toward the viewer across the very surface of the river, wings spread upward and outward, one hoof pressing on the WATER SURFACE without sinking, other legs striding; proud focused gaze.
POWER: walking upon water without sinking, sharp rings of surface water and small splashes under the contacting hooves, no floating platform, no energy aura. [longma-c07]
SCALE & CAMERA: extremely low water-level angle, head, dragon scales, wings and advancing hooves fill the square, ordinary tall horse scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one late sun lights edges of bronze-gold scales and brown feathers, deep walnut shadow, ordinary river mist.
SURFACE: hard layered dragon scales visibly replace body coat, horse mane strands, tactile feather layering, wet dark hooves.
SETTING: river surface, only dark banks faintly visible. [longma-c07]
MOOD: awe-inspiring, powerful and imposing auspicious being, never evil, cute, calm or decorative. [longma-c02]
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least1024px; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or wings; no film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity/gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: PNG asli dilihat: satu kepala kuda dua mata, dua sayap sisi, empat kaki berkuku, satu ekor dan sisik naga besar jelas menutupi tubuh c01/c07. Kuku depan menyentuh permukaan air tanpa tenggelam, langkah maju/percikan/mane bergerak c07. Semua tujuh Uji Sangar ya: subjek agung pada thumbnail, bukan kuda peternakan karena sisik/sayap terbaca; tanpa peta, warna varian741, efek aura, teks/gore atau desain adaptasi. Kontak thumbnail asli berukuran200 piksel dilihat ulang bersama13 PNG lane-A; ciri subjek dan kesan sangar/agung tetap terbaca.

root_visual_review.notes: Dragon-scaled horse with two side wings striding across a river surface without sinking; one head, four legs.
